title: Specification-Driven Data Architecture Reconstruction: From Physical Code to Logical and Conceptual Specifications
abstract: arXiv:2609.13929v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Legacy database migrations often begin with incomplete or outdated documentation, leaving physical data definition language (DDL) as the principal evidence of data architecture. However, DDL does not fully encode conceptual intent, and model-generated completions can be plausible without being correct. This study proposes and evaluates a provenance-aware, deterministic-first pipeline for reconstructing logical and conceptual data specifications from Oracle-oriented DDL while explicitly separating observed facts, deterministic derivations, and large language model (LLM) suggestions. The pipeline performs DDL investigation, parsing, consolidation, primary-key backfilling, type normalization, and declared relationship-graph construction before optional LLM-assisted enrichment. translated_title: 规范驱动的数据架构重构：从物理代码到逻辑与概念规范
translated_abstract: 遗留数据库迁移通常始于不完整或过时的文档，这使得物理数据定义语言（DDL）成为数据架构的主要证据。然而，DDL并不能完全编码概念意图，模型生成的补全内容可能看似合理但并不正确。本研究提出并评估了一种具有来源感知、确定性优先的流水线，用于从面向Oracle的DDL中重构逻辑与概念数据规范，同时明确区分观察到的事实、确定性推导和大语言模型（LLM）建议。该流水线在可选的LLM辅助增强之前，执行DDL调查、解析、整合、主键回填、类型规范化以及声明关系图的构建。它在确定性目录和声明关系图中保留源数据的来源信息，并将推断出的主键和外键候选记录在独立的目录中。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种具有来源感知、确定性优先的流水线，可从面向Oracle的DDL中重构逻辑与概念数据规范，通过明确分离观察到的事实、确定性推导和LLM建议，确保重构结果的正确性与可追溯性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a provenance-aware, deterministic-first pipeline for reconstructing logical and conceptual data specifications from Oracle-oriented DDL, explicitly separating observed facts, deterministic derivations, and LLM suggestions to ensure correctness and traceability.
